answer: Put hardware security module signature with monotonic counter at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Faking 504 identities means 504 fresh proofs and 47880 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. The river sits in the mechanism itself, the zephyr sits in the price of faking it, and the crystal sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
